5847.title: Shell intent parsing promotes a trailing output filter
5847.rootCauseOneLine: Shell intent parsing skips an unrecognized initial command and promotes a later grep filter to the entire command's search title.
5847.proposedFix: Keep non-exploratory first segments on the generic command-title path and preserve search-first pipelines; add an event-to-title regression table.
5847.caveats: No destructive payload or macOS desktop session was run. Exact aggregate heading and the separate expansion preference were not verified. CLI command details remain intact.
